;a set of three readings are stored in memory location starting 
;from 9050H, sort the readings in ascending order.


ORG 8000H           ; Program starting address

START:
  LXI H, 9050H        ; Initialize memory pointer to the start of the data
  MVI D, 00H          ; Clear swap flag (D = 00H means no swap occurred)
  MVI C, 02H          ; Initialize loop counter for 3 elements (Requires 2 comparisons)

CHECK:
  MOV A, M            ; Load current element into Accumulator
  INX H               ; Move pointer to the next element
  CMP M               ; Compare current element (A) with next element (M)
  JC NEXTBYTE         ; If A < M, it's already in ascending order, skip swap
  JZ NEXTBYTE         ; If A == M, skip swap

; --- Swap Logic ---
  MOV B, M            ; Save next element in temporary register B
  MOV M, A            ; Move current element (A) into next element's position
  DCX H               ; Move pointer back to current element's position
  MOV M, B            ; Move saved element (B) into current element's position
  INX H               ; Restore pointer to next element to continue array scan
  MVI D, 01H          ; Set swap flag to 01H (indicating a swap took place)

NEXTBYTE:
  DCR C               ; Decrement comparison counter
  JNZ CHECK           ; If C is not zero, check the next pair of bytes

; --- Pass Complete: Check Swap Flag ---
  MOV A, D            ; Move swap flag to Accumulator
  CPI 01H             ; Check if a swap occurred (Is D == 01H?)
  JZ START            ; If yes, restart a new pass to ensure fully sorted

RST 1               ; Terminate the program cleanly

; --- Data Segment Definitions ---
ORG 9050H
DB 87H, 56H, 75H    ; Array to be sorted
